laws.recognition_boundary: Aho-Corasick finds keys; K'UHUL interprets keys.
laws.exhaustive_before_collapse: Recognition may emit overlapping matches; semantic collapse remains phase-bound.
laws.ngram_address_book: An n-gram is an address into a semantic book, not only a probability feature.
laws.failure_link_boundary: Failure links provide structural fallback candidates, not semantic reasoning.
laws.learned_fold_algebra: The fold can carry learned combining algebra phi_t and update future behavior through feedback.
laws.hof_orthogonality: Phase and higher-order operation are orthogonal axes.
laws.kuhul_fold_container: K'UHUL fold is a semantic execution container, not identical to catamorphism.
laws.non_competing_engines: Key grammar and K'UHUL folds are not competing semantic engines; key grammar is fast n-gram key addressing, while folds are learned computational semantic algebra.
laws.speed_vs_computation: Key grammar provides speed through n-gram dictionary matching; K'UHUL folds require computation over active/inference fields.
laws.inference_field_2d_surface: The inference field provides the graph/matrix surface for FoldGraph 2D bit-pattern matching.

semantic_interpretation.fold_loop: B,Q -> Ana_psi_t -> F_Q -> WCR_t -> F*_Q -> Cata_phi_t -> C_Q -> Reward -> delta(psi,W,C,R,g,phi)

higher_order_family.hylo: ana then cata; generate then reduce
higher_order_family.meta: cata then ana; fold then unfold

foldgraph_2d_bit_pattern_law.boundary: 2D bit-pattern matching is projection/inference over a field surface, not semantic authority by itself.
